messages:
clare: quick heads-up — targeting prod promotion for v2.8.0 today at 17:30 PT. change includes model routing fix + batching tweak. please ack if any blocking concerns.

 dave: i'll own the deploy. plan: canary 5% (17:30–17:40), ramp to 100% at 17:45 if smoke green. rollback tag: v2.7.9. i'll post progress in this thread. :rocket:

 raj: noted. tests look good on my end. one ask — can we keep canary longer if p95 latency spikes > 20%?

 dave: yes can extend canary to 30m if needed. will watch latency dashboards.

 deploy-bot: deploy queued by dave. canary target=5% namespace=prod image=redwood/v2.8.0 SHA=abcdef0

 clare: CS/Marketing heads — @jen @sophie, marketing wants to push the banner at 18:00 PT and CS needs a short FAQ. we should freeze mention copy by 17:50.

 jen: marketing on it. i'll share banner copy in #marketing-drafts at ~17:40. need any customer-risk bullets?

 sophie: CS will be on standby 17:25–18:30. pls post short release notes here. quick FAQ: what to tell customers about performance changes?

 clare: paste for FAQ — keep short:
 - what changed: model routing fix to reduce tail-latency
 - impact: small perf improvement, no breaking changes
 - action: none required; contact support if you see errors
 Feel free to edit.

 raj: FYI i ran a canary smoke script, snippet below:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-lu2","prompt":"smoke test"}'
# assert 200 && latency < 500ms
```

 dave: thanks. smoke checklist i'll run during canary:
 - run smoke requests from us-west and eu-west
 - sanity checks on token usage and errors
 - validate fallback routing
 - warm KV caches
 - post rollout ledger entry
 I'll mark done as i go.

 clare: ops reminder — rollback plan:
 - dave triggers rollback job: `kubectl set image deploy/api redwood=redwood/v2.7.9 && kubectl rollout restart deploy/api`
 - if >5% error rate or p95 latency > 2x baseline in 15m, rollback
 - notify #incidents and CS

 sophie: copy. i'll prepare canned response for top 3 failure modes.

 jen: once ramp complete i'll schedule social post at 18:15. also confirming no paid campaigns tied to this push.

 dave: starting canary now. posting logs below.
 deploy-bot: canary started 1768800520
 dave: canary 5% live — running smoke tests.

 deploy-bot: smoke-test: 20/20 OK; avg lat=320ms; errors=0

 raj: latency looks fine. no anomalies in traces.

 clare: awesome. extend to 50% at 17:40 unless anyone objects.

 jen: no objections.

 sophie: CS ready. i'll standby for customer pings.

 dave: ramped to 50% -> 100% at 17:46. all checks green. posting final notes in acct.

 dave: rollout complete 17:46 PT. release notes:
 - v2.8.0 promoted
 - fixes: routing + batching
 - perf: median token latency -8%, tail improved
 - rollback tag: v2.7.9
 Thanks all.

 deploy-bot: release complete. CI/infra snapshot saved SHA=abcdef0
